metas.name: Mulholland Drive
metas.description: After a car wreck on Mulholland Drive renders a woman amnesiac, she and a Hollywood-hopeful search for clues and answers across Los Angeles in a twisting venture beyond dreams and reality.

metas.name: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
metas.description: A middle-aged husband's life changes dramatically when his wife asks him for a divorce. He seeks to rediscover his manhood with help from new acquaintance Jacob, who teaches him to pick up women at bars.

metas.name: Ocean's Eleven
metas.description: A thief and his team of associates plan a sophisticated heist to rob three Las Vegas casinos at the same time.

metas.name: Zootopia 2
metas.description: Brave rabbit cop Judy Hopps and her friend, the fox Nick Wilde, team up again to crack a new case, the most perilous and intricate of their careers.

metas.name: The Revenant
metas.description: A frontiersman on a fur trading expedition in the 1820s fights for survival after being mauled by a bear and left for dead by members of his own hunting team.

metas.name: Lucky
metas.description: Lucky follows the spiritual journey of a 90-year-old atheist and the quirky characters that inhabit his off the map desert town.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: Five assassins aboard a swiftly-moving bullet train find out that their missions have something in common.

metas.name: Mystic River

metas.name: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
metas.description: Shang-Chi, the master of weaponry-based Kung Fu, is forced to confront his past after being drawn into the Ten Rings organization.

metas.name: The Furious
metas.description: A father fights fiercely against ruthless kidnappers to save his abducted daughter.

metas.name: The Truman Show
metas.description: An insurance salesman begins to suspect that his whole life is actually some sort of reality TV show.

metas.name: Mad Max: Fury Road
metas.description: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a woman rebels against a tyrannical ruler in search for her homeland with the aid of a group of female prisoners, a psychotic worshipper and a drifter named Max.

metas.name: Rush
metas.description: James Hunt and Niki Lauda, two extremely skilled Formula One racers, have an intense rivalry with each other. However, it is their enmity that pushes them to their limits.

metas.name: La La Land
metas.description: When Sebastian, a pianist, and Mia, an actress, follow their passion and achieve success in their respective fields, they find themselves torn between their love for each other and their careers.

metas.name: Catch Me If You Can

metas.name: Donnie Darko

metas.name: Companion

metas.name: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
metas.description: Doctor Strange teams up with a mysterious teenage girl who can travel across multiverses, to battle other-universe versions of himself which threaten to wipe out the multiverse. They seek help from the Scarlet Witch, Wong and others.

metas.name: American Beauty

metas.name: The Long Walk
metas.description: A group of teenage boys compete in an annual contest known as "The Long Walk," in which they must maintain a certain walking speed or get shot.

metas.name: The Covenant

metas.name: A Clockwork Orange

metas.name: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

metas.name: Scream

metas.name: The Goonies
metas.description: A group of young misfits called The Goonies discover an ancient map and set out on an adventure to find a legendary pirate's long-lost treasure.

metas.name: The Lion King
metas.description: Lion prince Simba and his father are targeted by his bitter uncle, who wants to ascend the throne himself.

metas.name: The Voyeurs
metas.description: Pippa and Thomas move into their dream apartment, but notice that their windows look directly into the apartment opposite. This will set in motion a chain of events that will lead to disaster.

metas.name: Speak No Evil
metas.description: A family is invited to spend a whole weekend in a lonely home in the countryside, but as the weekend progresses, they realize that a dark side lies within the family who invited them.

metas.name: Sense and Sensibility

metas.name: Full Metal Jacket

metas.name: The Grand Budapest Hotel

metas.name: The Bourne Identity

metas.name: Airplane!

metas.name: No Hard Feelings

metas.name: The Holdovers

metas.name: The Gorge

metas.name: 2001: A Space Odyssey

metas.name: Die My Love

metas.name: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse

metas.name: It Follows

metas.name: Coco

metas.name: Kill Bill: The Whole Bloody Affair

metas.name: Captain America: The First Avenger
metas.description: Steve Rogers, a rejected military soldier, transforms into Captain America after taking a dose of a "Super-Soldier serum". But being Captain America comes at a price as he attempts to take down a warmonger and a terrorist organiza...

metas.name: Enemy

metas.name: Romeo + Juliet

metas.name: Deadpool

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3

metas.name: Kill Bill: Vol. 1

metas.name: Babylon

metas.name: The Deer Hunter
